notes: Starting cash now scales with difficulty: Easy 775 growing to Hard 925, Expedition 975, Boss Rush 1,000, and Voidcore 1,500.
No bosses or mini-bosses in the first 10 waves of any mode (Voidcore keeps its own pacing); mini-bosses return on every 5-wave mark, and each mode's final boss still guards the last wave.
Voidcore wave 13's spawner spam is cut (brood 14 to 6) and every voidcore wave's spawn counts were capped - the 30-50 wave slog is now survivable.
Wave rewards now follow the same ratio as starting cash: Easy is the base, and every harder mode pays proportionally more (Voidcore wave bonuses are nearly double).
Endless no longer spams the campaign finale - it scales chaff forever with mini-bosses on the 5-wave marks.
